name: Kinich Ahau
subtitle: Lord of Judgement
description: This hero story is yet to be revealed.
lore: Kinich Ahau is the sun god of Omeyocan, though he is neither the first sun nor the last. His gaze conveys the right of rulership, including its knowledges, its responsibilities, and—especially now—its judgment. Some believe he assimilates kings after their deaths. Other tales claim his wrath will one day devour the world, a fear that has grown since the Shattering.
divinity_generator: Gain [30] Divinity when this hero is inflicted with damage.

awakening_bonuses.bonus: Attunement Multiplier +50%, Armor Multiplier +30%, Weapon Multiplier +30%

skills.name: Sacred Brand
skills.description: Attack all enemies (200%DEF+130%ATK) with a 50% chance to place [mechanic:aetherburn-ii] for 2 turns.

skills.name: Unrelenting Authority
skills.description: Attack all enemies (230%DEF+140%ATK) with a 75% chance to place [mechanic:atk-down-ii] and [mechanic:blunt-ii] for 2 turns.

skills.name: Solar Barrier
skills.description: When an ally is damaged by an enemy, transfer 50% of the damage to this hero and increase the damage of the ally’s next ability by 10%.
